name: Activity inconsistent with customer profile
description: Transactions or withdrawals are uncharacteristic of, or inconsistent with, the customer's known profile, income or expected activity.
fp: Life events, windfalls or changed circumstances may explain the change.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)
FinCEN, Advisory on Elder Financial Exploitation (2022)
UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)
FCA, Guidance for firms on the fair treatment of vulnerable customers (FG21/1, 2021)
FATF, Best Practices: Combating the Abuse of Non-Profit Organisations (Recommendation 8) (2015; updated 2023)
FATF, Risk of Terrorist Abuse in Non-Profit Organisations (2014) and related guidance (general)
Charity regulators' published guidance on financial crime (general)

links.name: Activity inconsistent with customer profile
links.ctx: Turnover, counterparties or products exceed or depart from expected behaviour.
links.fp: Life events and growth change behaviour.

links.name: Uncharacteristic large withdrawals or transfers
links.ctx: Victim-side: unusual cash or transfers inconsistent with usual pattern.

links.name: Donations inconsistent with fundraising profile
links.ctx: Receipts out of line with size, reach or history of the NPO.
